protocol.written: PROTOCOL v2 in the tools/audit_inject.py docstring, before the first v2 run; v1 and the audit's rules unchanged
protocol.why: v1 sites are 'a number followed by a unit word' (the audit's own R2 binding) and v1 planted no operator flips
protocol.register: public SL feed 20261006: 1688 limitations, 1624 distinct DE/FR/IT text triples
protocol.eligible: one representative per distinct triple, no baseline finding of any kind: 1597 limitations (27 triples with a baseline finding excluded)
protocol.sampling: per type and target language (fr, it): random.Random('20261011:<type>:<lang>') shuffle, first 100 with a site; one fault per copy
protocol.number_tokens: this file's NUM2/NUMW2 patterns: digit tokens not glued to a preceding letter, dates, number words 2..12 (not hyphen-joined); excluded only: BAG indication codes (ddddd.dd, ddddd.XX), Index Therapeuticus group codes (after 'I.T.', or zero-padded dd.dd), other multi-separator references (RS 832.112.31)

types.number_any: one number token drawn uniformly from all included tokens of the target, changed as v1 (years +/-1; dates: day or year +/-1)
types.number_word: one number word 2..12 anywhere in the target changed to another (v1 rule)
types.operator: one comparison operator within 25 characters of a number (same sentence) flipped: fr: <, >, au maximum, au minimum, au moins, au plus, inférieur, maximum, minimum, moins, plus, supérieur, ≤, ≥; it: <, >, al massimo, almeno, inferior, massim, meno, minim, oltre, più, sotto, superior, ≤, ≥
types.negation: one negation within 60 characters of a number (same sentence) dropped: fr 'ne/n' ... pas', 'non'; it 'non'

detection.number_any: as v1 number: number finding with the new value on the target side or the old value on the German side
detection.operator: a target-language finding pointing to the place: a number/unit finding naming a value of a number token within 60 characters of the edit, or an editorial/terminology surface within 30 characters
detection.any: the limitation has any finding (all were finding-free before the injection)

protocol.execution: as v1: register statistics rebuilt from each modified register, shipped terminology pairs, audit.run_all on the copy's limitation; equivalence to a full-register run checked on the 'verification' copies

summary.note: pooled over types with equal n per type: a summary of this protocol's mix, not of real error frequencies
